description: Per-metric time-aggregation methods (ADR-0007). Every served sub-annual BLS, FRED and FBI UCR metric has one entry. Only an entry with status `approved` may authorize a derived value; `draft` entries are proposals awaiting review, and `not_aggregable` is the safe default.

entries.rationale: BLS computes annual average employment as the sum of the 12 monthly estimates divided by 12 (Handbook of Methods, CES calculation, AE13).
limitations: This series is seasonally adjusted; BLS's AE13 formula is stated for its estimates and publishes annual averages for not seasonally adjusted series, so a derived mean of adjusted months can differ slightly from BLS's annual average.

entries.rationale: BLS weights annual average hours by employment and annual average earnings by hours (AWH13 = sum of weekly hours / sum of employment; AHE13 = sum of payrolls / sum of hours); the aggregate hours and payrolls are not served, so a plain mean would not be BLS's figure.

A count of offenses or clearances reported for each month; a calendar quarter or year is the sum of its months, provided every month is reported.
limitations: An agency that did not report a month makes the window incomplete; it is refused, never treated as zero.

entries.rationale: A rate per 100,000 population; a window's rate must be recomputed from summed counts and the population, and no monthly population series is served, so it is not averaged.
